prompt: In this historical Zeta checkout, a failed session creation can leave a partial session directory, and session discovery then crashes on that missing metadata. Fix creation and discovery so a failed write does not publish a session, and sessions with missing or corrupt files do not prevent healthy ones from being listed. Preserve existing sessions, including unrelated pre-existing directories. Do not edit tests/test_session_publication_regression.py. Run its test and the existing session tests before finishing. When running Python tests inside this checkout, use PYTHONPATH=src:. so imports resolve to the checkout rather than the installed harness.

setup.tests/test_session_publication_regressio:
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from zeta.core.session import SessionManager


def test_discovery_skips_a_session_without_metadata(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    manager = SessionManager(tmp_path)
    good = manager.create(provider="fake", model="offline")
    partial = manager.create(provider="fake", model="offline")
    (partial.store.session_dir / "meta.json").unlink()

    assert [item.session_id for item in manager.list_sessions()] == [good.metadata.session_id]
    assert [item.session_id for item in manager.list_session_previews()] == [good.metadata.session_id]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("damage", ["missing", "corrupt_header", "corrupt_tail"])
def test_discovery_skips_unopenable_conversation(tmp_path: Path, damage: str) -> None:
    manager = SessionManager(tmp_path)
    good = manager.create(provider="fake", model="offline")
    bad = manager.create(provider="fake", model="offline")
    if damage == "missing":
        bad.store.path.unlink()
    elif damage == "corrupt_header":
        bad.store.path.write_text("broken\n")
    else:
        with bad.store.path.open("a") as handle:
            handle.write("broken\n")

    assert [item.session_id for item in manager.list_sessions()] == [good.metadata.session_id]
    assert [item.session_id for item in manager.list_session_previews()] == [good.metadata.session_id]


def test_failed_creation_does_not_publish_a_partial_session(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    manager = SessionManager(tmp_path)

    def interrupted_write(self: SessionManager, metadata: object) -> None:
        assert list(manager.sessions_dir.iterdir()) == []
        raise OSError("interrupted metadata write")

    monkeypatch.setattr(SessionManager, "_write", interrupted_write)
    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="interrupted metadata write"):
        manager.create(provider="fake", model="offline")
    assert list(manager.sessions_dir.iterdir()) == []


def test_racing_creation_preserves_foreign_directory(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    manager = SessionManager(tmp_path)
    original_write = SessionManager._write
    collisions: list[Path] = []

    def racing_write(self: SessionManager, metadata: object) -> None:
        original_write(self, metadata)
        if not collisions:
            path = manager.sessions_dir / metadata.session_id
            path.mkdir()
            (path / "keep.txt").write_text("foreign")
            collisions.append(path)

    monkeypatch.setattr(SessionManager, "_write", racing_write)
    opened = manager.create(provider="fake", model="offline")

    assert len(collisions) == 1
    assert (collisions[0] / "keep.txt").read_text() == "foreign"
    assert opened.store.session_dir != collisions[0]
    assert [item.session_id for item in manager.list_sessions()] == [opened.metadata.session_id]
